usage.basis: Pokémon % = share of ladder teams. Move, item and ability % = share of that Pokémon's sets.

habits.source: Pokémon Showdown replays, [Gen 9 Champions] VGC 2026 Reg M-C, the 5,000 highest-rated games (ratings about 1550-1940), October 2026
habits.note: bring: share of games a Pokémon in a team preview was brought (seen in battle); lead: share it led. Only Pokémon in at least 40 previews. Used to weigh which of their unseen Pokémon they brought.
